steps.why: assemble the legacy code files into the expected environment
draft a Python translation of the GLM model
execute the unmodified legacy R code in a network‑isolated sandbox
compare row‑by‑row outputs of the translation against the legacy execution
repair any detected discrepancies in the translation
issue a certification once parity is achieved

data.rationale: The fuzz analysis will expose edge cases that may not surface in typical data, ensuring robustness of the translation. This comprehensive approach guarantees functional equivalence and reliability of the rebuilt model.
